metadata.title: Philippe Laffont's Bold Q2 2026 Move: Micron Technology Inc at a 7.07% Portfolio Impact

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Coatue Management's Tech-Heavy Strategy Reveals Major Bets and Exits in Latest 13F Filing
Philippe Laffont (Trades, Portfolio), the founder of Coatue Management, has submitted his 13F filing for the second quarter of 2026, offering a window into the investment strategy of one of the tech sector's most prominent hedge fund managers. A protege of Julian Robertson's Tiger Management (Trades, Portfolio), Laffont established Coatue in 1999, and the firm has since become renowned for its concentrated, technology-focused approach. With offices in New York, Edison, New Jersey, and Menlo Park, California, Coatue employs a fundamental analysis framework that combines long and short strategies with top-down stock selection. The firm's portfolio is heavily weighted toward information technology, which accounts for over half of its allocated assets, followed by consumer discretionary at roughly a third, with additional positions in healthcare, utilities, telecommunications, and energy.
Summary of New Buys
Philippe Laffont (Trades, Portfolio) added a total of 9 new stocks to the portfolio during the quarter, with the most significant additions being:
-
The most significant addition was Space Exploration Technologies Corp (NASDAQ:SPCX), with 18,561,780 shares, accounting for 6.52% of the portfolio and a total value of $3.17 billion.
-
The second largest addition to the portfolio was Intel Corp (NASDAQ:INTC), consisting of 12,084,027 shares, representing approximately 3.47% of the portfolio, with a total value of $1.69 billion.
-
The third largest addition was Cerebras Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CBRS), with 7,011,028 shares, accounting for 3.19% of the portfolio and a total value of $1.55 billion.
Key Position Increases
Philippe Laffont (Trades, Portfolio) also increased stakes in a total of 8 stocks, with the most notable increases being:
-
The most notable increase was Micron Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MU), with an additional 2,976,338 shares, bringing the total to 3,142,269 shares. This adjustment represents a significant 1793.72% increase in share count, a 7.07% impact on the current portfolio, and a total value of $3.63 billion.
-
The second largest increase was Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN), with an additional 3,904,033 shares, bringing the total to 11,834,799. This adjustment represents a significant 49.23% increase in share count and a total value of $2.82 billion.
